subunit: Interacts with MAPK3/ERK1. Interacts with KCNH2. Associates with ribosomes. Interacts with SGIP1; involved in negative regulation of endocytosis. The palmitoylated form interacts with the ribosome-translocon complex component SSR1, promoting efficient folding of glycoproteins. Interacts with SERPINA2P/SERPINA2 and with the S and Z variants of SERPINA1. Interacts with PPIB. Interacts with ZNRF4. Interacts with SMIM22. Interacts with TMX2. Interacts with TMEM35A/NACHO. Interacts with CHRNA7. Interacts with reticulophagy regulators RETREG2 and RETREG3. Interacts with DNM1L; may form part of a larger protein complex at the ER-mitochondrial interface during mitochondrial fission. Interacts with ADAM7
